texts.label: R4924, 22 Apr 1543
texts.summary: Sadler at Edinburgh to Henry VIII, 22 April 1543: Sir George Douglas warns that the Governor Arran has turned against Henry and written secretly to Cardinal Beaton and the French-party earls, advises holding the Scottish ambassadors as surety and writing henceforth in cipher, and offers to deliver the country south of the Forth to an English army.
texts.note: Decryption: the contemporary decipher (f. 218) as printed by Clifford, Sadler State Papers I (1809), pp. 158-160 (archive.org), with Bain's corrections in Hamilton Papers I (1890) no. 362; linked, no local copy yet. No transcription of the ciphertext (DECODE images not viewed).
